cues: Recall from Unit 10: heat ethanol with concentrated sulphuric acid at one hundred and forty degrees, and two molecules share one water, giving diethyl ether.
It is cheap and used in industry.
But it only works for simple ethers.
Mix two different alcohols and you get all three possible ethers, which are hard to separate.
